sections.title: Habit and range
sections.text: Chamaecrista aldabrensis is a small perennial subshrub, woody at the base and spreading, known from Aldabra and Assomption in the Seychelles. It grows about 15–40 cm tall. Its 1–1.5 cm leaves bear several pairs of tiny leaflets; the yellow flowers are 5–6 mm across.

sections.title: Flowers and pods
sections.text: The pubescent pod is about 2–2.5 cm long and contains seeds about 2.5 mm long. The plate matches the low habit, compound leaves, yellow flower and pod; details are enlarged without a scale. No food use or specific hazard is established.

sources.title: Flora of the Seychelles: Dicotyledons — Friedmann, IRD/MNHN
